scenarios.drivers: 12-month horizon to 2027-09-06. Street-low NTM EPS (FY2026E 0.75 / FY2027E 0.77), -22% below the mean. Three adverse drivers that earnings/07 states COMPOUND rather than offset: credit cost +110bp to the Q1'26 11.6% level (-USD 583.3m); BRL at the company's own disclosed 17.8% shock (-USD 577.9m); effective tax rate reverting to the 30.2% consensus embeds (-USD 549.4m at the zero-mitigation bound, -USD 302.2m at the measured 45% realised offset). Multiple compresses to the region of 06's named-comparable base (10.68x, the midpoint of BTG Pactual 9.39x and Credicorp 11.97x), still a 36% premium to the 7.73x peer median. Deliberately below 02's observed 12.90x floor because 02 s2 states the true full-cycle low sits below it (20-month window contains no downturn). Independently corroborated by 03's peer-implied 16.5% cost-of-equity route at USD 7-9.
scenarios.source: 07_scenario-and-fair-value.md s3 scenario table and 'the bear case reaches a cited through-cycle trough'; Capital IQ Estimates -> Consensus, EPS (GAAP) Low row, as-of 2026-08-29; 06_sum-of-the-parts.md s2 (10.68x named-comp region)

scenarios.label: bear_structural
scenarios.drivers: 24-36 month horizon - a DIFFERENT point in time from the three cases above; do not blend silently. Avoid-ruin / permanent-impairment floor, NOT the 12-month bear. Built as an impaired residual-income (excess-return) model, not metric x multiple, so no metric/multiple pair is recorded: opening book USD 2.7160 + PV of explicit residual income USD 3.2160 + PV of a NEGATIVE terminal USD -0.2859 = USD 5.6461 at 2026-06-30, accreted x1.0203 to USD 5.7607. Return on equity fades from 35.5% (FY2028) to 12.0% by FY2033, BELOW the 13.0% cost of equity, with terminal growth cut to 1.5% nominal USD (negative real). Trigger: business-model/07_business-quality rate-of-change 38/100, RF-BQ-005 fast-changing industry (CLAUDE.md s24 Filter 5); the eroding-moat leg did NOT fire (09_moat: Narrow, stable). Equity-direct, so already net of debt - no net-debt subtraction.

method_notes.own_history: 02's own-median P/TangBV of 7.91x on LTM tangible book -> USD 19.60. TRAILING basis and ZERO weight, as required: 02 s4 states in its own header that its 20-month (not 3-5 year) window makes the reversion figures 'illustrative only and NOT a fair-value input for 07'. Its full illustrative field is USD 17.84-22.01. Excluded from the dispersion gate for the same reason.
method_notes.peers: 03 s5 base point: warranted NTM P/E 15.18x x NTM EPS USD 0.97. Own dispersion USD 12.10-17.44, plus a separate peer-anchored cost-of-equity route at USD 7-9 that disagrees by ~2x and is carried into the bear rather than averaged. Anchor flagged cycle-elevated (RF-VAL-001) -> method confidence capped 60.
method_notes.dcf: 04 is a residual-income (excess return on equity) model discounted at the cost of equity, NOT an FCFF DCF - the Business-Type Method Map bars an FCFF DCF and the EV bridge as a value for a Financial. Value USD 11.71 as of 2026-08-28. Not terminal-dominated (terminal 15.3% of value). Held to the cross-check third because ~47% of value comes from a self-built 10-year fade benchmarked against a one-broker strip.
method_notes.sotp: 06 collapsed single-segment value (Banking = 100% of revenue and pre-tax profit). ZERO weight on its own producer's instruction: arithmetically the same construction as 03 (same NTM EPS 0.97, same 2026-08-29 comp set), so weighting it would be one read counted twice. Retained in the football field, which makes the full valid value-producing field USD 10.36-14.73 = 42.2% and fires the >40% dispersion cap.
method_notes.dispersion: Full high-to-low field of valid value-producing methods = 10.36 -> 14.73 = 42.2% of the low. MODULE_RULES Reconciliation Gate 6 fires -> valuation confidence max 55 (stated 52).

discount_rate.note: There is no WACC in this model and its absence is structural, not an omission: for a Financial the Method Map requires the equity to be valued directly at the cost of equity, so the after-tax k_d <= WACC < k_e bound has only one leg and does not apply [04 s3]. CAPM build k_e = 4.79% + 0.94 x 4.23% + 3.24% Brazil country-risk premium = 12.01% computed; 13.00% USED after a stated +0.99pp analyst override (inside the +/-1.5pp discipline). Comparators: company's own disclosed Brazilian cost of equity 16.51% (FY2025 20-F Note 3(b)) = 13.98-14.54% translated to USD; market-implied 11.58% (05). No RF-VAL-003 escalation fired.
